Swami's Monthly Sunday Social Ride is a road group ride in Carlsbad, CA. Schedule: One Sunday a month (time posted on the club calendar); weekly World Famous Saturday Ride from Encinitas, from Bird Rock Coffee Roasters, Bressi Ranch. About 33 miles, 2x2, conversational, no-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: 2x2, conversational, no-drop. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @swamiscycling the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Swami's Monthly Sunday Social Ride group ride

North County's big club opens one ride a month to anyone comfortable with 30 miles: a two-by-two, conversational, no-drop loop from a coffee shop in Bressi Ranch. Its weekly Saturday A/B ride out of Encinitas is the fast one, and it is not no-drop.
